name: Context Window & Compaction Limits (272k)
description: Raises the model context-window constant from 200000 to 272000 tokens and slightly increases the autocompact reserved-buffer constant from 13000 to 13600, both as same-length numeric literal swaps inside the minified main app module. Derived from InDreamer/claude-context-patch; the upstream script's additional 95%/90% effective-window function-body rewrites are length-changing and intentionally excluded to preserve binary integrity.

provenance.author: InDreamer
provenance.derived_by: anchored against pristine 2.1.158 using 2.1.88 source ref

operations.rationale: Per-model token-budget block: raise context window 200000->272000 (same length, 6 digits). Structurally unique 4-field var block; 3 other =200000 literals in the binary have different surrounding fields and do not match.

AUTOCOMPACT_BUFFER_TOKENS/MANUAL_COMPACT_BUFFER_TOKENS block: raise reserved autocompact buffer 13000->13600 (same length, 5 digits). Unique via trailing ,=3000,=0.2; structure; only =13000 literal of this shape in the binary.
